summary.text: Ginny Shaver, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 39 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She is president of the Cherokee County Republican Women and vice-chair of the Cherokee County Republican Executive Committee.
She was appointed to the Cherokee County Industrial Development Board, previously worked with the Gadsden Airport Authority and is a certified municipal clerk.
